records.title: Wildwood
records.starring: Carey Mulligan, Angela Bassett, Tantoo Cardinal, Tom Waits, Richard E. Grant, Jemaine Clement, Jake Johnson
records.synopsis: Wildwood is a handcrafted epic fantasy adventure that transports audiences into a secret, magical, and dangerously alive world just beyond their doorstep. At its heart is the story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel (PROO muh-KEEL), on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.

records.title: You Can See Everything
records.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING.

records.title: Wicker
records.starring: Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Peter Dinklage, Elizabeth Debicki
records.synopsis: THERE IS NO TRAILER LINKED FOR THIS MOVIE DUE TO GRAPHIC CONTENT!!!

records.title: Drummer Boy
records.starring: Lucas Leach, Joel David Smallbone, Beth Easdown
records.synopsis: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family each search for freedom in a world built to deny it. With music carrying hope through battle and loss, Drummer Boy turns the Revolution into a deeply human story of faith, forgiveness, and the belief that no person is born to live in chains or be forgotten.

records.title: American Sniper
records.starring: Bradley Cooper, Sienna Miller, Jake McDorman, Luke Grimes, Navid Negahban, Keir O'Donnell
records.synopsis: FOR ONE DAY ONLY!!! SEE IT THIS VETERANS DAY, WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 11!!!

records.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
records.starring: Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Miou Tanaka
records.synopsis: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO picks up in 1949, two years after the tumultuous events of Godzilla Minus One, and continues the story of the Shikishima family as they face an all-new calamity.

records.title: The Cat in the Hat
records.starring: Bill Hader, Bowen Yang, Matt Berry, Paula Pell, Xochiti Gomez, Quinta Brunson
records.synopsis: In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, THE CAT IN THE HAT comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, doing what he does best--spreading joy to 'happyless' kids. In the film, The Cat takes on his toughest assignment yet... to cheer a pair of siblings struggling with their move to a new town.

records.title: Ghost Soldier
records.starring: Jim Caviezel, Olivia Thirlby, Beau Knapp, Garret Dillahunt, Shea Whigham
records.synopsis: In the action-thriller Ghost Soldier, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action — he’s actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can’t win.

records.title: Rocky 50th Anniversary
records.starring: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young, Carl Weathers, Burgess Meredith
records.synopsis: FOR 2 DAYS ONLY!!! SEE IT NOVEMBER 7TH AND 8TH!!!

records.title: How to Rob a Bank
records.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their beliefs - and their most ambitious heist yet.

records.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
records.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING will revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

records.title: Ebenezer
records.synopsis: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The name you know, the story you don’t. From Ti West, EBENEZER also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

records.title: Hexed
records.synopsis: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad and produced by Roy Conli, Disney’s “Hexed” opens exclusively in theaters November 25, 2026.

records.title: Hershey
records.synopsis: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

records.title: Focker-In-Law
records.synopsis: This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

records.title: Violent Night 2
records.synopsis: Santa's back. And he's not happy. From 87North, the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde, Nobody and this summer's Nobody 2, comes a new chapter in yuletide mayhem: VIOLENT NIGHT 2. In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee David Harbour), armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of ruthless mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, it's time for not-so-jolly Saint Nick to suit up again. VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is produced by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch and will be released by Universal Pictures.

records.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
records.synopsis: An empire in decay. A ruler consumed by fear. A star rising over Bethlehem. When Christ is born, Herod’s terror erupts into the slaughter of the innocents, and Mary must protect the child promised to save the world. As violence spreads and hope flickers, the true battle begins—not for a throne, but for the soul of mankind.
